name: Patil Khanaval
area: Rajendra Prasad Road, opposite Murud Beach
signature_dish: Surmai fish thali with sol kadhi
why_it_matters: Murud's reigning fish-thali institution opposite Murud Beach — open-air dining under coconut trees, no-frills home-style Konkani cooking. The fish thali (rice + surmai curry + fried pomfret + sol kadhi) for ₹350-400 is the lunch order. Catch is morning-landed at Rajapuri jetty. 4.0+ on Tripadvisor across 100+ reviews.
insider_tip: Fish thali sells out by 2pm on weekends — arrive 12:30 or call ahead. Ask for nira (fresh palm sap) if you're curious about the local pre-fermentation drink. Cash + UPI; no cards.
signature_address: Rajendra Prasad Road, opposite Murud Beach, Murud 402401

name: Sea Shell Resort Restaurant
area: Murud Beach Road, opposite Janjira jetty
why_it_matters: Beachfront resort with one of Murud's most consistent in-house kitchens — Konkan fish curries + occasional tandoor, the catch comes from Rajapuri jetty each morning. Open to non-residents. Pool + restaurant share the same compound, 200m from the Janjira boat jetty.
insider_tip: Order from the day-catch board, not the printed menu — fish availability rotates daily. Pool-side seating in the evening is the calm-dinner option after the village shuts down at 9pm.
signature_address: Murud Beach Road, opposite Janjira jetty, Murud 402401

name: Vinayak Lodging & Restaurant
why_it_matters: Family-run lodge + restaurant at Bhandarwada with table seating facing Murud Beach. Konkani home-cooking; the prawns masala with bhakri (jowar flatbread) is the village-Konkan signature combo. Open 7am-11pm; breakfast 7-10:30am, lunch + dinner Konkani thalis.
insider_tip: Beach-facing tables at sunset (6-7pm) book out — call ahead. Dal khichdi is the comfort-food order for non-fish travellers.

name: Murud Marina Restaurant
area: Murud Beach Road, opposite Murud Beach
why_it_matters: Murud Marina is a 16-room beach hotel with a family-restaurant attached, opposite Murud Beach. Traditional Konkani-style cooking — both veg and non-veg thalis. Open to non-residents; hotel has parking, useful for road-trippers arriving on weekends when Patil Khanaval is queued.
insider_tip: Veg thali at lunch (₹300-350) is the family-group order. Open 7am-10:30pm. Book the parking-side wing rooms — sea-side wing is closer to the jetty but louder.
signature_address: Murud Beach Road, opposite Murud Beach, Murud 402401

name: Yashraj Beach Resort Restaurant
area: Murud Beach, near Datta Mandir foot
why_it_matters: Pure-vegetarian resort + restaurant at Murud Beach — the most reliable veg-only option in a non-veg-dominant beach town. Maharashtrian thali + snacks; runs a swimming pool + cottages too. Open 7am-10:30pm.
insider_tip: The veg thali is ₹200-250 — the value-for-money order for vegetarian travellers reluctant to eat at fish-led restaurants. Pool entry is paid separately for non-residents.
signature_address: Murud Beach, near Datta Mandir hill foot, Murud 402401
